title: RPP-5a TABLESTYLE legacy row CMC, roles, and text-style handle fast slice

authoritativeReference.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, version 5.4.1

fields.description: Three row styles, in data/title/header order
Each row has six ordered borders, each with lineweight BS, visibility B, and border color CMC

changes: Generated TABLESTYLE data/title/header rows now carry distinct text heights, alignments, text/fill indexed colors, and standard text-style hard-pointer handles.
The data row exercises distinct true-color CMC values for text and fill: the text color also has color/book names, while fill RGB has no optional names.
The read callback verifies row order/identity, both CMC payloads and metadata, text-style handles, and existing border CMC values.
